carrier.selection: fixed identity; not chosen by target score

policy.deployment: raw_action=mu; no sample, verifier, reference, reward or gradient

training.candidate_group: same prefix and exogenous source sequence

objective.task: macro hard Dice for RL; macro soft Dice for post-training SUP
objective.retention_anchor: same sampling policy and pre-window memory; clone readouts, no commits
objective.kl: analytic raw Gaussian forward KL; mean active dimensions
objective.all_equal_group: zero advantage; no resampling; common KL still evaluated

validation.family_selection: mean of first-two-seed selected validation score
validation.sampled_mean_gap: 16 source-cal episodes, 4 samples, selected checkpoint only; diagnostic, no selection

target.primary: domain equal, OD/OC equal, principal orders equal, policy seeds equal
target.endpoint_sensitivity: all 70 main source slots at round 4000; reuse identical artifacts
